Description: Establish clear
Implementation_Steps: focused research questions before beginning
Key_Tools: 1. Review literature; 2. Identify gap; 3. Write specific questions; 4. Check clarity with advisor
Success_Indicators: Research journal; advisor; literature review database
Common_Pitfalls: Questions are specific; answerable; novel
Timeline: Too broad; not testable; lack of focus

Description: Document detailed methodology and analysis plan
Implementation_Steps: 1. Write methods section; 2. Specify procedures; 3. Define outcomes; 4. Plan analysis
Key_Tools: Word/LaTeX; statistical software; protocol templates
Success_Indicators: Clear procedures; defined measures; pre-analysis plan
Common_Pitfalls: Vague methods; flexible analysis; p-hacking opportunity

Description: Pre-register design with external registry for transparency
Implementation_Steps: 1. Choose registry (OSF; ClinicalTrials.gov); 2. Submit protocol; 3. Receive registration
Key_Tools: OSF Registries; ClinicalTrials.gov; discipline-specific registries
Success_Indicators: Public registration; time-stamped; pre-analysis plan locked
Common_Pitfalls: Late registration; post-hoc registration; selective registration

Description: Get institutional review for human subjects research
Implementation_Steps: 1. Complete CITI training; 2. Develop consent form; 3. Submit to IRB; 4. Respond to queries; 5. Receive approval
Key_Tools: CITI training platform; IRB; protocol templates
Success_Indicators: IRB approval letter; documented consent process
Common_Pitfalls: Missed deadlines; incomplete submission; late review

Description: Develop realistic schedule with milestones and deliverables
Implementation_Steps: 1. Break project into phases; 2. Estimate time per phase; 3. Identify dependencies; 4. Build in contingency; 5. Share with advisor
Key_Tools: Project management software (Asana; Monday); Gantt charts; calendar
Success_Indicators: Written timeline; approved by advisor; slack built in
Common_Pitfalls: Unrealistic estimates; no contingency; dependent tasks not identified

Description: Record decisions; procedures; rationale throughout research
Implementation_Steps: 1. Choose medium (physical or digital); 2. Record daily; 3. Document decisions; 4. Note deviations; 5. Date all entries
Key_Tools: Lab notebook software (Notion; Obsidian); physical notebook
Success_Indicators: Complete record of decisions; dates; justifications
Common_Pitfalls: Incomplete recording; post-hoc documentation; illegible entries

Description: Establish naming conventions and folder structure
Implementation_Steps: 1. Design naming scheme (date_project_description); 2. Create folder hierarchy; 3. Document structure in README; 4. Version all files
Key_Tools: File management system; version control (Git); cloud storage
Success_Indicators: Consistent naming; logical structure; easy retrieval
Common_Pitfalls: Inconsistent naming; deep folders; unclear versions

Description: Establish 3-2-1 backup system for data protection
Implementation_Steps: 1. Identify primary working copy; 2. Set automated cloud backup; 3. Create external drive backup; 4. Test restoration; 5. Document process
Key_Tools: Cloud storage (Google Drive; OneDrive; Dropbox); external drive; encryption
Success_Indicators: Multiple copies; different media; offsite copy; tested restoration
Common_Pitfalls: Single copy; no backup; untested backups

Description: Document all variables; codes; units; and metadata
Implementation_Steps: 1. List all variables; 2. Describe each; 3. Specify units; 4. Document codes; 5. Note data source
Key_Tools: Data dictionary template; CDISC standards; spreadsheet
Success_Indicators: Complete documentation of all variables; codes explained
Common_Pitfalls: Incomplete documentation; vague descriptions; missing units

Description: Define analysis approach before seeing results
Implementation_Steps: 1. Write analysis plan; 2. Define primary outcomes; 3. Specify statistical approaches; 4. Identify hypothesis vs. exploratory; 5. Preregister
Key_Tools: Pre-registration template; OSF; protocol document
Success_Indicators: Written analysis plan; preregistered; primary/exploratory labeled
Common_Pitfalls: Flexible analysis; post-hoc exploration presented as primary; p-hacking

Description: Track changes to analysis code and scripts
Implementation_Steps: 1. Initialize Git repository; 2. Commit regularly; 3. Write meaningful messages; 4. Push to remote; 5. Tag releases
Key_Tools: Git; GitHub; GitLab
Success_Indicators: Regular commits; meaningful messages; clean history
Common_Pitfalls: No version control; infrequent commits; vague messages

Description: Record all analysis steps for reproducibility
Implementation_Steps: 1. Write commented code; 2. Document dependencies; 3. Create README; 4. Test reproducibility; 5. Share code
Key_Tools: Code editor; documentation template; reproducibility checklist
Success_Indicators: Fully commented code; clear documentation; reproducible workflow
Common_Pitfalls: Uncommented code; missing dependencies; unclear steps

Description: Draft sections and analyses throughout research
Implementation_Steps: 1. Schedule writing time; 2. Draft methods early; 3. Write results as they emerge; 4. Draft discussion; 5. Iterate
Key_Tools: Word processor (Google Docs; Overleaf); writing schedule
Success_Indicators: Regular drafts; iterative improvement; early completion
Common_Pitfalls: Leaving writing to end; single draft; rushed final writing

Description: Get feedback from advisor and peers on drafts
Implementation_Steps: 1. Develop schedule; 2. Share drafts; 3. Collect feedback; 4. Revise; 5. Iterate
Key_Tools: Shared document platform; comment features; scheduled meetings
Success_Indicators: Regular feedback cycle; documented comments; iterative revision
Common_Pitfalls: No feedback until final; defensive to criticism; single revision pass

Description: Choose appropriate venues for publication
Implementation_Steps: 1. Review discipline norms; 2. Search journal databases; 3. Check impact factors; 4. Review scope; 5. Select 3-5 options
Key_Tools: Google Scholar; Journal Citation Reports; publisher websites
Success_Indicators: Target list with rationale; appropriate scope match; journal metrics
Common_Pitfalls: Inappropriate journal choice; misalignment with scope; poor impact

Description: Share early findings through preprint server
Implementation_Steps: 1. Format according to guidelines; 2. Write clear abstract; 3. Choose appropriate server; 4. Submit; 5. Promote via social media
Key_Tools: bioRxiv; arXiv; OSF Preprints; Overleaf
Success_Indicators: Preprint posted; version tracked; cited by others
Common_Pitfalls: Delayed preprint; forgotten promotion; version confusion

Description: Submit research to peer-reviewed journal
Implementation_Steps: 1. Format per journal guidelines; 2. Write cover letter; 3. Select reviewers; 4. Submit; 5. Track status
Key_Tools: Journal submission portal; manuscript management tools; calendar
Success_Indicators: Submission confirmed; tracked in submission system
Common_Pitfalls: Late submission; format errors; incomplete submission

Description: Publish data and analysis code for reproducibility
Implementation_Steps: 1. Clean and de-identify data; 2. Create codebook; 3. Choose repository; 4. Add metadata; 5. Create DOI; 6. Cite in paper
Key_Tools: Zenodo; Figshare; OSF; dataverse; GitHub
Success_Indicators: Published with DOI; citable; license specified
Common_Pitfalls: Unpublished data; poor documentation; restrictive licensing

Description: Develop relationships for feedback and encouragement
Implementation_Steps: 1. Meet regularly with advisor; 2. Join peer writing group; 3. Attend seminars; 4. Find mentor; 5. Network at conferences
Key_Tools: Scheduling tool; community platforms; professional societies
Success_Indicators: Regular advisee meetings; active peer group; mentor relationships
Common_Pitfalls: Isolated effort; no feedback; lack of support

Description: Protect mental health and sustainability throughout PhD
Implementation_Steps: 1. Schedule breaks; 2. Set work hours; 3. Exercise regularly; 4. Seek support; 5. Celebrate milestones
Key_Tools: Calendar; exercise tracking; counseling services; support groups
Success_Indicators: Regular breaks; maintained schedule; support accessed when needed
Common_Pitfalls: Burnout; unsustainable pace; isolation; mental health decline
